data.verdict: ROUTE C REFUTES ITS OWN PREMISE (honest, useful): |c| CANNOT be made a convention-free single scalar. The canonical geometric-mean representative c = 0.99470743 is basis-invariant but scale-covariant, so its magnitude stays τ-gated. CONSEQUENCE for the workplan: convention does not cancel; a well-defined |c| needs the τ=P categorical identification to fix the overall scale, OR the physical c must be redefined as one of the intrinsic scale-invariant scalars (an owner modeling choice, not derivable here). Nothing wired; 1/(8π) phase-4; scope-(a).
